mode.desc.sprint: Follow the checkpoints to the goal and beat your rival. The next checkpoint is always shown on screen by an arrow.
mode.desc.flags: Collect the 5 hidden flags before the time runs out. The flags can be collected in any order.
mode.desc.score: Tricks and stunts galore! The key to success is building up the COMBO, so pull off as many tricks as you can on the way to the goal. Whatever you do, don't slow down!
mode.desc.challenge: Your rivals teach you new tricks. Learn them and use them against the rivals!
mode.desc.free: Run with no time limit and practise your moves.
mode.desc.warmup2: Learn to move smoothly and use the surroundings to get an edge.
mission.bestGhost.desc: Race the echo of your own record: it runs your best line next to you, and the gap shows at every checkpoint.

rules.title: Rules
rules.text:
Meet Playman, his sister Blaise and 8 rivals who share one passion: extreme running!

Beat every rival on time, score and style on the way to the highest rooftops of the city and become the best runner.

In single player you play as Playman or Blaise.

Your character never stops. Plan your moves so you don't have to stop.

Try not to stumble. Land carefully after long jumps.

Pulling off lots of tricks flawlessly builds up the COMBO. The higher the COMBO, the more points you get.

All the moves are listed in the "Moves" menu.
hints.wallTurn: Hint: press BACK just before touching a wall to TURN faster and earn points.
hints.landing: Hint: to soften the LANDING, press DOWN before touching the ground.
hints.controls: Learn the basic controls! Use up, left, right and down to move. Running is automatic.
prize.title: Congratulations!
prize.text: You have completed every mission in the city. Thank you for playing Parapet, a remake of Playman Extreme Running (Mr. Goodliving, 2007). Fonts: Terminus and Russo One.
